quote: Vendor will notify the customer within 96 hours of confirming a security incident affecting the customer's data.
policy_quote: Vendor must notify us within 72 hours of detecting a breach affecting our data. Violation: notice window >72 hours, or no specific window stated.
reason: 96 hours is longer than the 72-hour maximum. The policy lists a notice window over 72 hours as a violation.
suggested_fix: Shorten §7 so notice is given within 72 hours of detecting a breach that affects our data.
